about_the_game:
This is a time-traveling life simulation game that immerses players in a blend of historical and fictional realities.

As a benevolent helper and a traveler across time, come to the aid of our endearing yet conflicted heroine. With new possibilities on the horizon, how could we possibly stand still?

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In this realm of endless adventures, we extend our utmost respect to the creator of "Papers, Please" and to all indie game developers who have pushed the boundaries of gameplay with their remarkable explorations. Their innovations inspire us to traverse not just the annals of history but also the frontiers of gaming creativity.
